dataset.name: World Pixel provider index: Gauteng
dataset.notes: Gauteng edition. Every record carries its source and the date it was checked. Positions are area centres (locationPrecision: area), not building coordinates. Records marked verified were confirmed on the provider's own site; the rest are shown as unverified. Nothing here is invented.

providers.name: Keybase Training Solutions
providers.category: Private computer and office-skills training centre
providers.description: Training centre operating since 1990, accredited with MICT SETA, Services SETA, ETDP SETA and the QCTO. Computer courses run from Introduction to PCs through Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Access and Outlook, at its venue, online or at your premises.
providers.source: Provider's own website (keybasetraining.co.za, Microsoft Office training page). Checked 3 October 2026.
providers.note: The map position is the middle of the area, not the building, so distances are approximate. Use the address and the Directions button.

providers.name: Learnfast Training Centre
providers.description: Short-course provider that presents Microsoft Office courses at its Midrand campus, online, or at a client's premises.
providers.source: Provider's own website (learnfast.co.za, Microsoft Office courses page). Checked 3 October 2026.
providers.note: The map position is the middle of the area, not the building, so distances are approximate. Use the address and the Directions button.

providers.name: Soweto Computer Centre
providers.description: Computer college offering part-time courses in Soweto. Its site lists typing, file management, CV writing, interview preparation, Word, Excel and PowerPoint (levels 1 to 3) and Outlook, with registration open for Office Administration and End User Computing.
courses: Office Administration and End User Computing
providers.source: Provider's own website (sowetocomputercentre.carrd.co). Checked 3 October 2026.
providers.note: The site gives the street address above and also describes the centre as at Black Chain Shopping Centre, next to Bara Taxi Rank. Phone before you travel. The map position is the middle of the area, not the building, so distances are approximate. Use the address and the Directions button.
